title: TypeScript project configuration (local subset)
description: Offline stand-in for https://json.schemastore.org/tsconfig. It is referenced from tsconfig.json via its $schema property so that editor validation works without network access; it checks the top-level shape only. Option-level hints come from the TypeScript extension, and the real check is `npx tsc --noEmit`.

$schema.description: Path or URL of the schema used to validate this file.

extends.description: Path(s) of base tsconfig files to inherit from.

compilerOptions.description: Compiler options; see https://www.typescriptlang.org/tsconfig for the full list.

files.description: Explicit list of files to include.

include.description: Glob patterns of files to include.

exclude.description: Glob patterns of files to exclude.

compileOnSave.description: Ask the IDE to compile the project on save.
